subject: Quarter kickoff — stakeholder compact & metrics gating
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
To: markus_klein@redwood.com, lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Cc: Gina Torres <gina@acme.com>, psuccess@cloudpartner.io
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Quarter kickoff — stakeholder compact & metrics gating

Team —

We’re kicking off the quarter OKR alignment for product + GTM owners. Instead of the usual long slides, I want us to land a compact that:

- Summarizes the objective and owner for each top-line OKR (1 page per objective)
- Defines 2–3 gating metrics with clear thresholds (go/no-go) and the owner for each metric
- Lists dependencies (infra, security, partner integrations) and the action owner + ETA

Attached: Q2_metrics_gating_template.xlsx (simple gating tab) and owner_compact_v1.docx (example).

Asks:
1) Please fill the template for your owned objectives and return by EOD Friday, July 2.
2) Confirm the primary metric and the gating threshold in the sheet (we need binary clarity: green = go, red = escalate).
3) Confirm the owner and backup for each objective.
4) Note any cross-team dependencies in the dependency tab.

I’ll run a 30m alignment the following week to validate compacts and lock any changes. Tentative invite: Tue, Jul 6 at 10am PT.

Context: leadership wants a tighter gating approach this quarter to shorten decision cycles for rollouts (esp. Dedicated and Private deployments). This compact is the artifact we’ll use in the QBR packet.

Thanks — please be direct; we need fewer iterations on this.

—Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Q2_metrics_gating_template.xlsx, owner_compact_v1.docx
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa@redwood.com>
Cc: lauren_bishop@redwood.com, grace_oconnor@redwood.com, vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 30 Jun 2027 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Quarter kickoff — stakeholder compact & metrics gating

Thanks Vanessa — quick clarifications before I populate: 

> Asks:
> 1) Please fill the template for your owned objectives and return by EOD Friday, July 2.
> 2) Confirm the primary metric and the gating threshold in the sheet (we need binary clarity: green = go, red = escalate).

Two specific questions:
1) For the Serving runtime objective I plan to use 95th-pct latency (p50/p95 split already in the sheet). Do you prefer absolute ms targets (e.g., p95 < 220ms) or relative improvement vs baseline (e.g., -15% vs Q2 average)? We’ll hit different player expectations if we mix.
2) For the Dedicated capacity objective — I suggest moving owner to Grace for day-to-day execution and keeping me as escalation owner (I can still be listed as backup). Any objections?

Also, Gina from Acme is on the thread — does Acme’s test traffic count toward the gating metric or do we only include in-house canary traffic? If external consumption is included we need to coordinate sampling windows.

I’ll wait for confirmation on the two points and then upload the sheet.

-Markus
Director, Product Engineering
Redwood Inference

All — thanks for the quick back-and-forth. Final decisions below for the compact population: 

- Metrics approach: use absolute targets for gating where possible (p95 in ms for latency; embedding cost per 1k tokens as $$). Add a relative delta column for context but mark gating column as absolute threshold.
- Serving runtime p95 target: 220ms (owner: Markus Klein; backup: Vivek Kulkarni).
- Dedicated capacity objective owner: Grace O'Connor (owner); Markus is escalation owner.
- External partner traffic: include Acme sample in the gating analysis but annotate whether the data is production vs pilot. Gina — please confirm you can provide the 48-hour sample next week (Jul 6–7).
- Dependencies: Product infra will deliver a dashboard feed by Jul 8 (action owner: Vivek).

Vanessa — I’ll accept the tentative Jul 6 10am PT alignment; I’ll also add a 15m pre-read window (20m) so owners can flag any remaining blockers.

Please update the templates and I’ll consolidate into the QBR packet on Jul 9.

—Lauren Bishop
Head of GTM Strategy
Redwood Inference
